paragraphs: Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai; Ulla ben Zakkai (Chullin 52a, according to the reading of Tosafot there, s.v. "ne'ekra"); Rabbi Pinchas ben Zakkai (Moed Katan, chapter 2, halakhah 1).[^1]

notes.text: Tosafot on Chullin 52a, s.v. נעקרה צלע טרפה, reads Ulla bar Rabbi Zakkai. Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:1 names Rabbi Pinchas be-Rabbi Zakkai. These particular title forms are not silently substituted for Hyman’s labels or merged into one identity.
